original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-derived-pushforward-composition}
Let
$f : (\Sh(\mathcal{C}), \mathcal{O}_\mathcal{C}) \to
(\Sh(\mathcal{D}), \mathcal{O}_\mathcal{D})$
and
$g : (\Sh(\mathcal{D}), \mathcal{O}_\mathcal{D}) \to
(\Sh(\mathcal{E}), \mathcal{O}_\mathcal{E})$
be morphisms of ringed topoi.
Then $Rg_* \circ Rf_* = R(g \circ f)_*$ as functors
$D(\mathcal{O}_\mathcal{C}) \to D(\mathcal{O}_\mathcal{E})$.

final_content.statement:
For arbitrary ringed-topos morphisms $f$ and $g$, the unbounded right derived direct images $Rf_*$ and $Rg_*$ are computed by K-injective resolutions, since module sheaves form Grothendieck abelian categories. No boundedness/flatness assumption is present.

Let
$f : (\Sh(\mathcal{C}), \mathcal{O}_\mathcal{C}) \to
(\Sh(\mathcal{D}), \mathcal{O}_\mathcal{D})$
and
$g : (\Sh(\mathcal{D}), \mathcal{O}_\mathcal{D}) \to
(\Sh(\mathcal{E}), \mathcal{O}_\mathcal{E})$
be morphisms of ringed topoi.
Then $Rg_* \circ Rf_* = R(g \circ f)_*$ as functors
$D(\mathcal{O}_\mathcal{C}) \to D(\mathcal{O}_\mathcal{E})$.
hypotheses: $f:(\mathrm{Sh}(\mathcal C),\mathcal O_{\mathcal C})\to(\mathrm{Sh}(\mathcal D),\mathcal O_{\mathcal D})$ and $g:(\mathrm{Sh}(\mathcal D),\mathcal O_{\mathcal D})\to(\mathrm{Sh}(\mathcal E),\mathcal O_{\mathcal E})$ are composable morphisms of ringed topoi.
conclusions: There is a canonical isomorphism $Rg_*\circ Rf_*\cong R(g\circ f)_*$ of functors $D(\mathcal O_{\mathcal C})\to D(\mathcal O_{\mathcal E})$ on **unbounded** derived categories.

semantic_review_note: For arbitrary composable ringed-topos morphisms f,g, unbounded derived direct images compose Rg_*Rf_*≅R(g∘f)_* with variance D(O_C)→D(O_E). No flatness or boundedness is asserted.
